title: Priority-anchored regional failover orchestration and deterministic restore validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce an operational playbook and validation harness for active-passive regional failover that enforces priority-based traffic evacuation, deterministic restore checks, and coordinated circuit-breaker/load-shedding behavior. This ticket covers: 1) a runbook for a scheduled live drill that exercises promotion of the passive region, 2) snapshot/restore integrity checks for critical state (tokenstore, KV cache, routing metadata), 3) verification of SLO preservation under controlled degraded capacity using circuit breakers and load-shedding policies, and 4) clear rollback and post-mortem actions. The output must be scriptable and runnable by on-call and SRE, with minimal manual steps and reproducible verification artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Automated drill runbook executes end-to-end with run log and timestamped artifacts in S3/drive
Primary->Passive switchover completed within documented RTO target for median traffic pattern
No irrecoverable data divergence: tokenstore and critical KV namespaces reconcile with >=99.99% key parity within 10 minutes post-switchover
SLO regressions: 99th percentile latency remains within emergency SLO guardrail or system falls back to safe-mode with documented error budget consumption
Circuit-breaker thresholds correctly trip under simulated overload and result in documented load-shedding behavior (per-route)
Rollback path validated by an automated rollback run that restores traffic to original primary and validates state consistency
All run artifacts, dashboards, and a concise incident-style postmortem template are produced and linked in the ticket
playbook_steps: Pre-drill: announce window to stakeholders, snapshot critical clusters and record current leader map
Prechecks: verify snapshot checksum, validate cross-region snapshot accessibility, run KV consistency smoke tests
Throttle external traffic to canary rate and mark canary traffic tag for observability
Activate passive-region warmup: ensure model runtime kernel cache primed for expected seq lengths
Trigger controlled promotion: flip routing policy to passive region using runbook operator (orchestration API), route only priority-anchored traffic initially
Observe: monitor circuit-breaker states, per-route shedding counters, tokenstore reconciliation progress
Increase traffic in staged steps while watching SLO and error budget dashboards
If predefined thresholds exceeded, execute automated rollback or progressive draining as specified
Post-switchover: run deterministic restore verification suite against tokenstore and KV namespaces
Tear-down: resume normal routing, capture final snapshots, archive logs and artifacts
test_plan: Run a dry-run in staging using recorded production traffic trace (20% scale) and validate timing of each playbook step
Simulate primary-region network partition and verify passive-region promotion completes without human intervention beyond operator confirmation
Introduce synthetic overload to exceed per-route circuit-breaker thresholds and assert that shedding metrics reflect expected droppage rates
Corrupt a non-critical KV namespace in staging and validate our restore verifier detects divergence and rejects the restore if checksum mismatch
Run backup restore on a point-in-time snapshot and validate application-level assertions for 100 sample requests
Run canary rollback sequence and validate state reconciliation and traffic stability
monitoring: alerts: SLO-99th-latency > guardrail for 2 consecutive minutes, circuit-breaker-trip-count spike > 5/min, restore-check-failure
logs: centralized runbook executor logs in GCS with correlation-id, KV-checker reports with key-diff summaries
tracing: distributed traces should identify slow hop (eg. block in KV reconciliation or tokenstore write)
rollback_plan: If SLO regression exceeds emergency threshold for >5 minutes, trigger automated rollback job that flips routing back to original primary
During rollback: run incremental snapshot comparison; if parity restored, mark rollback success; otherwise escalate to engineering lead
If rollback fails, initiate manual evacuation to cold standby and follow emergency DR contact list
Document rollback steps and attach logs to ticket within 2 hours
